notes.title: Big Improvements & New Features!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Dev Update – Big Improvements & New Features!
Hey everyone! I’ve been working hard on the game lately, and I’m excited to share some fresh updates and improvements. This update brings in new features, important bug fixes, and a few system reworks that I think you’ll enjoy:

- Bug Fixes
A lot of bugs have been cleaned up in this update — from small glitches to more noticeable issues. The game should now feel smoother and more stable all around.

- Pixel-Perfect Item Placement & Interaction
Item placement and interaction are now much more precise. Everything should feel more responsive and accurate when you're placing objects or interacting with the world.

- NPC Renaming
You can now rename NPCs! Give them custom names and make your colony feel even more personal and unique.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474260/19fb142f3c400b36822008e141ca9e9ef9b3b1df.gif[/img]

- Dynamic Fence Building
Fence and barrier construction is now dynamic, letting you build more freely and adapt to terrain and obstacles in real-time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474260/37216812c829de566b478cf0fb71be13cced2a21.gif[/img]

- New Building: Stone Mine
There's a brand new Stone Mine building! When placed against a mountain or rocky area, it’ll generate stones to help fuel your colony’s growth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474260/7d5a6b8dbd8a6fa137aeae9fd1dd4ab18700e6bb.gif[/img]

- Accurate Collision System
The building system now uses a more accurate collision system — which means fewer awkward placements and better alignment across the board.

- Prestige / Upgrade System Rework
I’ve reworked the prestige system: now, when you do a hard reset, only specific upgrades are affected — everything else continues forward. This makes progression smoother and less punishing.

- Smarter NPC Navigation
NPCs now navigate more intelligently and grab their targets with much better accuracy. Things should feel a lot more natural and responsive.

notes.title: New Features, Bug Fixes & Improvements!
notes.notes:
Game Update Log 🚀

We’ve been hard at work improving the game, and here’s what’s new:

✨ New Features:

Added the ability to scale the UI independently from the game world for better customization.
Introduced a refund system: If you delete a building right after buying it, you’ll get a full refund of the cost.
Added an option to hide the game UI when the mouse moves outside the game menu for a cleaner experience.



🐛 Bug Fixes:

Fixed the issue where storage could exceed its capacity.
I resolved a bug related to the hidden settings in the UI.
Adjusted Barry Bush’s growth rate to -17% for better balance.
Fixed text display issues for clearer readability.



🛠 Improvements:

Made tech tree buttons smaller to improve visibility and accessibility.
Added small visual differences between tents to add variety and make them more distinct.
Balanced the game mechanics for a smoother and more enjoyable experience.


Thank you for being so supportive, and keep the feedback coming! Let us know what you think of these changes. 😊

notes.title: Founders Legacy Demo
notes.notes:
Founders Legacy Demo is Here!

We're thrilled to announce that the demo for Founders' Legacy is now live! Dive into our relaxing idle colony builder that sits quietly at the bottom of your screen—perfect for multitasking while you work, study, or play.

Build Your Legacy: 
Start with humble beginnings and watch your settlement grow into a bustling community.

Endless Possibilities: 
Unlock new structures, upgrade resources, and shape your colony’s destiny.

Unwind & Create: Enjoy a stress-free, engaging experience that evolves with every decision you make.
Try the demo now, explore our world, and help us shape the future of Founders' Legacy! Let us know what you think.

notes.title: Founders' Legacy Public Demo is Coming! With Achievements!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce that Founders' Legacy will soon have a public demo available! 🎮 This is your chance to build, expand, and survive in my tiny colony builder before the full release!


What’s in the Demo?
Core Colony Building: Gather resources, manage villagers, and grow your settlement.
Steam Achievements: Unlock special Founder’s Marks for being part of the first settlers!
A Glimpse of the Legacy System: See how your choices impact the future.
The Storyteller: shapes your colony’s fate with dynamic events, unexpected challenges, and unique moments that define your legacy.


We’ll announce the release date very soon, so wishlist the game and stay tuned!
